purpose: Small bond/duration watchlist for capital-allocation research. Live Desk owns the rate state; Power Stack uses it to compare duration, inflation protection and cash alternatives.

monitorPolicy.rule: Keep the main Power Stack bond monitor small. Use a deeper rates sweep only when one of the core bond questions changes materially.
monitorPolicy.noSignalRule: This is not an automatic buy/sell engine. It is a research and capital-allocation comparison layer.

buckets.label: Cash / Short Treasury
buckets.question: Is the short end paying enough to justify patience versus adding equity risk?
buckets.whatMatters: 3M/6M bills, 2Y yield and expected Fed path.
buckets.triggerForDeeperResearch: Front-end yields fall materially, Fed path changes, or equity risk premium improves enough to reduce the cash hurdle.

buckets.label: Intermediate Duration
buckets.question: Is 7–10Y duration becoming attractive before the long end fully stabilises?
buckets.whatMatters: 10Y nominal yield, 10Y real yield, breakevens and growth data.
buckets.triggerForDeeperResearch: 10Y yield/real yield peaks or begins a sustained decline while inflation expectations remain contained.

buckets.label: Long Duration
buckets.question: Has the term-premium/inflation/supply shock gone far enough to make long-duration convexity interesting?
buckets.whatMatters: 20Y/30Y yields, auction/supply conditions, term premium, real yields and credit/risk transmission.
buckets.triggerForDeeperResearch: Long yields stop making new highs, auction/liquidity stress improves, or growth risk starts dominating inflation risk.

buckets.label: Inflation Protected
buckets.question: Is the inflation problem mostly real-yield pressure or a renewed inflation-expectations problem?
buckets.triggerForDeeperResearch: Breakevens rise materially without equivalent nominal-yield adjustment, or real yields reverse while inflation risk stays sticky.

nextDeepSweep: Add verified US 20Y and 30Y yields to the canonical monitor if missing.
Decompose long-end moves into real yield, breakeven inflation and term premium.
Check Treasury auctions/supply and liquidity rather than using yield level alone.
Compare USTs with JGBs/Bunds and USDJPY before calling the move US-specific.
Compare SGOV/BIL/SHY, IEF, TLT and TIP on yield/duration/convexity rather than treating 'bonds' as one trade.
